professionalService.problemSolved: Explains the vertical organization and level-three workspace of one authored multilevel timber building to a client or design reviewer.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: An exploded building stacks from the ground upward, holds an upper-level gap to reveal the studio, then lowers the overhead plate as the camera traverses that same floor.
professionalService.decisionValue: Clarifies spatial relationship between levels and occupied studio in this study; the apparent weekly construction sequence, stretched core and roof garden are authored demo claims rather than Rubik project facts.

evidence.statement: Donor description specifies floor stack, level-three gap and level-four lowering.
Full A→B sequence shows stacking, entry and overhead descent.

continuityInvariants.statement: Concrete ground, central core, perimeter timber grid and level-three desks remain in the same building as floor gaps close.
The studio seen from axon is the level entered by the camera while the same level-four plate hangs over it.
The level-four soffit descends toward the same timber columns, desks and perimeter facade, preserving the workspace relation.
